'''Core Craft''' was a company that worked as the main contractor and supplier for the [[Sarlacc Project]], a secret project that was implemented by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], to construct a [[Super Star Destroyer prototype|prototype Super Star Destroyer]]. Core Craft helped with the construction of [[Imeici Spire]], a [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscraper]] in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that served as the headquarters of the Sarlacc Project. A number of materials designated for use in the construction of Imeici Spire were stored in [[Core Craft Staging Area 70]], the 70th floor of a Core Craft skyscraper warehouse that was located on the edge of CoCo Town.
